description: Calculates the length of daylight at a place on a date, with sunrise and sunset in UTC, for the UTC day from midnight to midnight. A place is one of the website's 20 cities or a latitude with an optional longitude.

date.description: UTC date as YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900 to 2100. Defaults to today in UTC.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, north positive: -90 to 90.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, east positive: -180 to 180. Defaults to 0 when only a latitude is given; it sets the UTC sunrise and sunset times.

place.description: City, one of Anchorage, Auckland, Buenos Aires, Cape Town, Dubai, Johannesburg, Lima, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Moscow, Mumbai, Nairobi, New York, Perth, Santiago, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney or Tokyo. Not needed when a latitude is given.

name: get_daylight_hours
title: Daylight hours
